      <span>A microglial process (blue) wrapped around a dendritic spine. Three slices through the tissue and one 3D view of the same cell, rendered from the link they sent.</span>

## Prose elements: code and tables

Inline `code` sits in the run of text. A fenced block:

```python
def open_link(url: str) -> None:
    """Open a Neuroglancer state in the default browser."""
    webbrowser.open(url)
```

| Layer type | Neuroglancer colour | Token |
|------------|---------------------|-------|
| Glia | purple | `--tag-glia` |
| Synapse | teal | `--tag-synapse` |
| Mitochondria | green | `--tag-mito` |

<section class="refs">
  <h2>References</h2>

    <li id="ref2">Paolicelli, R.C. et al. "Synaptic pruning by microglia is necessary for normal brain development." <em>Science</em>, 333(6048), 1456-1458, 2011. <a href="#doi2">doi:10.1126/science.1202529</a></li>
